remarks: Welcome to Gramercy Park! Exquisite, boutique enclave of eight luxury residences nestled in the heart of sought-after New Canaan, CT. Private and pristine, Unit 202 offers turn-key single-floor living, complete with elevator access (no stairs) & in-unit washer/dryer. This 2 bedroom, 2 full bath w/den residence features 1,573 sq. ft. of carefully crafted living space centered around a chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line SubZero/Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry & marble countertops, with seamless flow into an elegant main living/dining area. Light & bright primary bedroom with en-suite spa-like full bath w/marble finishes & generously-sized walk-in closet; 2nd bedroom with full bath and hallway powder room. Stunning, oversized covered balcony overlooking the serene & tastefully landscaped community garden for year-round outdoor enjoyment. Two dedicated parking spaces (one covered - #6), ample guest parking and complimentary use of the community clubhouse with outdoor kitchen, seating area and fitness center w/TV & Internet access. Offering secure entry and 24-hour package room for added peace of mind, Gramercy Park is a modern sanctuary brimming with charm, steps from exceptional dining, bespoke retail shops, parks, and vibrant local events -- all one hour from Manhattan. Several floor plans available beginning at $1,375,000; inquire with listing agent for details.
